citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(c:Camera)
WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z'
  AND ch.hour_utc <  '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  AND c.mode = 'crowd'
WITH ch.camera_location AS camera_location, ch.avg_hc AS avg_hc, ch.event_count AS samples
RETURN camera_location,
       CASE WHEN sum(samples) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE toFloat(sum(avg_hc * samples)) / sum(samples)
       END AS avg_head_count,
       sum(samples) AS total_samples,
       count(*) AS hours
ORDER BY camera_location
